0022600190.text: The Atlanta Hawks (5-4, first in the Southeast and fourth in the East) host the Brooklyn Nets (2-6, 13th in the East) on a two-game winning streak, though they are just 1-2 at home. Atlanta is missing Jalen Johnson (ankle), Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise). The teams have not met yet this season, but the Hawks won the 2025-26 series 4-0, including a 141-107 win in Brooklyn on April 3, 2026.
